description: This is a shell script for testing git fast-import functionality related to notes objects, including creating commits, adding notes, updating, deleting, and testing different fanout schemes in the notes trees.

methods.name: fast_import_commits
methods.description: Creates multiple commits in the specified branch with given content, appending the commands to a file.

methods.name: fast_import_notes
methods.description: Creates notes for specified commits across multiple references, appending commands to a file.
